title: Fix Puzzle3d Marquee Selection
description: Fix puzzle3d rectangle marquee selection false positives (random objects outside rectangle) and false negatives (objects fully inside not selected). Root causes: partial AABB corner projection behind camera, inflated world AABB footprint vs visible silhouette, crossing mode using arbitrary AABB corner diagonals.
summary:
Fixed puzzle3d rectangle/lasso marquee selection false positives and false negatives.

Root causes:
- Partial AABB corner projection when vertices were behind the camera produced collapsed bogus footprints.
- Window mode used the inflated world AABB bounding rect instead of the visible silhouette.
- Crossing mode tested arbitrary consecutive AABB corner pairs instead of hull boundary edges.

Changes in puzzle/3d/react/index.tsx:
- Added convexHullScreenPoints, projectWorldToClientMarquee, geometry-vertex sampling with cap, and ObjectMarqueeFootprint.
- projectObjectGroupToScreenPoints now returns { hull, anyBehindCamera } from mesh vertices (AABB fallback).
- MarqueeCandidate carries anyBehindCamera; window mode rejects straddling objects and requires all hull points inside the marquee; crossing uses convex-hull edges.
- Extended marquee unit tests (behind-camera exclusion, tight hull window select, hull-edge crossing, convex hull).

All 188 @puzzle/3d/react tests pass.
